answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a ember seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The reef receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 97 aliases trips the duplicate check at the wander gate. Each impostor pays 13 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
